label: HOLD
meaning: gate verdict: park for review; NOT terminal, never overrides the ledger

label: REJECT
meaning: gate verdict: drop; DURABLE — latest-terminal-wins in advice; only review --promote (a later PASS) clears it

label: :CLAUD_QA_HOLD:
meaning: parks a prepared change at the approval desk; box pops Apply/Hold/Reject; decision dated to advice/

label: QA-n
meaning: desk item id; row in CLAUD_QA_HOLD.md Open/Resolved tables

label: NOSIG
meaning: README-vouched unsigned .md on the pub shelf (listed reason required)

label: FURNITURE
meaning: README-vouched non-.md shelf file; vouches EXISTENCE not content (content sigs = v0.1)

label: .gate
meaning: dotfile sign-post: policy/reason/since (+embargo); nearest wins; silence != consent; fails closed

label: AI_GUARD_*_CLAUDE

label: .skill-manifest

label: attestations
meaning: expected principle lines pinned for the minions drift check

meaning: message marker: NO network/local-boundary crossing (SEMAPHORES.md registry governs).
